game.desc: Biohazard Revival Selection is a remastered version of two Biohazard games in 720p high-definition. The package contains HD versions of Resident Evil CODE: Veronica X and Resident Evil 4. The PS3 and Xbox 360 boxed releases are available in Japan, while in Europe and America these two games are available for download separately on XLBA and PSN.
